from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

input_path = Path("results/stress_components.csv")
output_dir = Path("postprocessed/stress")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

data = pd.read_csv(input_path)
required = {"element_id", "sxx_mpa", "syy_mpa", "txy_mpa"}
missing = required.difference(data.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing stress columns: {sorted(missing)}")

# Compute the plane-stress von Mises equivalent stress.
components = data[["sxx_mpa", "syy_mpa", "txy_mpa"]].astype(float)
sxx, syy, txy = components.T.to_numpy()
data["von_mises_mpa"] = np.sqrt(sxx**2 - sxx * syy + syy**2 + 3.0 * txy**2)
data = data.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=["von_mises_mpa"])
if data.empty:
    raise ValueError("No finite stress results are available.")

critical = data.nlargest(20, "von_mises_mpa")
critical.to_csv(output_dir / "critical_elements.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
ax.hist(data["von_mises_mpa"], bins=40, color="steelblue", edgecolor="white")
ax.set_xlabel("Von Mises stress (MPa)")
ax.set_ylabel("Element count")
ax.set_title("Element stress distribution")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(output_dir / "stress_distribution.png", dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)
